release_notes: The integration snippets in the campaign editor's Connection method — KClient JS and PHP, tracking script, banner blocks, click and conversion pixels, countdown, back-button and exit-intent widgets, WordPress shortcodes — generated with hardcoded Russian how-to comments no matter which language the panel was set to. Every template comment is now English, translated in place (not behind locale keys: this is code the user pastes into their own site). The only remaining Russian string is deliberate — the text_ru example in the WordPress shortcode demonstrates the multilingual parameter itself. No manual server steps are required.
